# v1.1.0-dev.55 — Support link, clearer update failures

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.54`. Small
release: no behaviour changes to saving, loading, or matching.

## New

- **Settings → Updates now has an About block** with a link to the
  project page and a support button, and the status bar carries a small
  "buy me a coffee" chip. WLM stays free either way — there is no nag
  dialog, nothing on first run, and no reminder that ever interrupts you.

## Fixed

- **Update failures explain themselves.** A dead feed or a failed
  download now names the manual download page instead of surfacing a
  raw socket error. The build is hosted off-site, so those failures are
  almost always the network in between rather than anything the app can
  retry around.
- The update dialog's button reads **"Open download page"** — it still
  said "View on GitHub" from before dev.53 moved distribution to
  dougfessler.com, and pointed somewhere that no longer served it.
- The Settings help text no longer claims the app polls GitHub Releases.
- **Status bar layout.** It used a fixed two-column grid, so a third
  item wrapped onto a second row the 22px height then clipped — which
  meant the vim mode indicator (the `g…` prompt) pushed the status text
  out of view whenever it appeared.

## Internal

- The screenshot harness no longer takes focus while it runs, so a
  keystroke during a capture can't land in the app and corrupt the
  documentation screenshots.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53+. Otherwise unzip and run.
